player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Player {player_id} ci Chopsticks. Ci tàmbali gi, tànnal benn ci:
  + Sóok:  '[attack M O]'  bu M=sàñu ga (0 walla 1), O=sàñu xarit ga (0 walla 1).
    - Limu sàñu xarit ga dafa wóor ci sa sàñu; bu >=5, mu nekk 0.
  + Sédd:   '[split L R]'  ngir séddale sa xélitam ci L ak R (L+R = sa xélit). 
Tontu ak benn ci ñaari komandu yooyu.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Xëtu xeexkat bi {opp_idx} dafa dee ba noppi.
invalid_move.split_sum: Yëy bi ñu damm war na tollu ci {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Sopp na soppi sa wàllug loxo.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Dakkare bu njaboot. Sàkk “[attack M O]” walla “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} dàkkaré P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: moo taxoon na {opp_val} ba {new_val}.

outcome.win: Ñaari loxoy xeexkat yi dee nañu.
